name: Ryuuzouji Kouzou
source: The headmaster of Sakaimachi Academy and accomplished historical researcher. He is an old friend of Arima Koudai, and is eager to get his hands on the research which has been left behind. He resides in an old samurai shrine near the school, where recent sightings have been reported.
